categories.main_business_segments: First Tractor Company Limited primarily operates in agricultural machinery manufacturing, power machinery manufacturing, and related components. Its main products include medium and large-sized wheeled and crawler tractors, non-road diesel engines, and various component products such as castings, forgings, gears, axles, transmissions, and injection pumps. The company also engages in R&D, manufacturing, and sales of these products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes independent innovation with core technologies including tractor power shift and CVT technology, intelligent driving technology, and electronic control technology. Production is mainly through mass assembly lines with extensive use of information technology to support customized products. The company also invests in intelligent manufacturing and green manufacturing, with a comprehensive industrial chain covering core components and complete machines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: First Tractor serves agricultural producers requiring mechanization and modernization, including users in paddy fields, dry fields, orchards, and hilly mountainous areas. Its diesel engines support agricultural machinery, engineering machinery, marine engines, and generator sets. The company sells agricultural machinery mainly through distributors domestically and internationally, and power machinery and components primarily to OEMs. Major markets include China and overseas regions such as Russian-speaking areas, Latin America, Asia, Africa, and Belt and Road Initiative countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a nationwide marketing network covering all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities. It also has significant overseas operations in Russian-speaking countries, Latin America, Asia, Africa, and countries along the Belt and Road Initiative. The company leverages SINOMACH's international engineering contracting resources to expand overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: First Tractor operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, manufacturing complete agricultural machinery and power machinery products. It has strong upstream control through in-house manufacturing of key components such as transmissions, engines, bodies, and cabs, enabling integrated industrial chain control and product quality assurance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology innovation leadership, focusing on high-end, intelligent, energy-efficient, and environmentally friendly agricultural equipment. R&D efforts target power shift, CVT, hybrid power, and intelligent driving technologies, as well as products adapted to hilly and mountainous terrains. It also emphasizes digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and green development, with increased R&D investment and talent cultivation to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of agricultural machinery, power machinery, and components. Agricultural machinery products are sold mainly via a distributorship model, while power machinery and components are sold directly to OEMs. The company also provides financial services to dealers and end users to support sales. Investment income and government subsidies contribute to other income streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: First Tractor is a leading domestic agricultural machinery manufacturer in China with a strong market position, especially in large and medium tractors. It holds competitive advantages through its comprehensive industrial chain, technological innovation, and brand influence. The industry is characterized by increasing concentration among leading companies, with competition shifting to multi-factor dimensions including technology, brand, service, and financial support.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 11.9 billion, a 3.26% increase year-on-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 922 million. Total assets reached RMB 14.69 billion, with net assets attributable to shareholders at RMB 7.26 billion. The company has shown steady growth with a focus on profitability and operational efficiency, supported by increased R&D investment and cost management.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: First Tractor emphasizes product excellence, brand distinction, and innovation leadership. Its value proposition includes providing reliable, technologically advanced agricultural machinery tailored to diverse agricultural scenarios, including specialized products for hilly and mountainous terrains. The company leverages its integrated industrial chain for quality assurance and cost control, and offers comprehensive after-sales service and financial support to customers, enhancing user experience and market competitiveness.
